OPTIONS
       --onto <newbase>
           Starting point at which to create the new commits. If the --onto option is not
           specified, the starting point is <upstream>. May be any valid commit, and not just an

       -i, --interactive
           Make a list of the commits which are about to be rebased. Let the user edit that list
           before rebasing. This mode can also be used to split commits (see SPLITTING COMMITS

OPTIONS
      --build-arg list         Set build-time variables
      --cache-from strings     Images to consider as cache sources
      --cgroup-parent string   Set the parent cgroup for the "RUN"

  -f, --file string            Name of the Dockerfile (Default is
                               "PATH/Dockerfile")
      --force-rm               Always remove intermediate containers

  -t, --tag list               Name and optionally a tag in the
                               "name:tag" format
      --target string          Set the target build stage to build.

OPTIONS
       -name pattern
              Base of file name (the path with the leading
              directories removed) matches shell pattern

       -type c
              File is of type c:


       -maxdepth levels
              Descend at most levels (a non-negative integer)
              levels of directories below the starting-points.
